incidents.body: We’ve resolved the delays that were affecting updates for some workspaces hosted in our US region, and service should now be operating normally. incidents.body:
This incident has now been resolved and Linear should now be loading normally again for all users.

We identified an error with DDOS protection rules being applied in error, and applied mitigation changes to prevent this from affecting user logins.

If you still run into problems accessing Linear after a refresh, please reach out to [support@linear.app](mailto:support@linear.app "support@linear.app").

incidents.body: Task processing in our EU region was briefly delayed from 12:45 to 13:05 UTC after capacity scaled down too far, which slowed some background actions from completing normally. We scaled capacity back up and processing has recovered. Service should now be operating normally.
incidents.title: Resolved - Delayed background processing for some users in EU region

incidents.body: Earlier today, some US customers may have seen degraded or incomplete search results for a number of hours. This issue has now been resolved, and search should be working normally again. The impact was caused by backed-up event processing, which has since been cleared. We’re sorry for the disruption and are continuing follow-up work to help prevent similar issues.
incidents.title: Resolved: Degraded search quality for some US workspaces

incidents.body:
We’ve resolved the issue that caused delays in background task processing and search indexing.
Systems are now operating normally again. Recent changes should appear as expected in search, and you should no longer experience delays with notifications, webhooks, automations, or other event-driven updates.
Please contact [support@linear.app](mailto:support@linear.app) if you continue to see related issues.
incidents.title: Investigating delays in background processing
